en: Black‑and‑white winter street scene in a small town with snow‑covered road and wooden fences. Large wooden houses line both sides; signs on two buildings read "Victoria Hotel" and "Sevaldsen Hotel". People are visible in the distance. At the top right is printed the town name "Tønset." The rest of the front is covered with handwritten text in a Scandinavian language.
